units.zh: 又河南、河間、樂陵等諸王，或以時嫌，或以猜忌，皆無罪而殞，非所謂知命任天道之義也。
units.en: Moreover, the princes of Henan, Hejian, Leling, and others all died guiltless, some from the suspicions of the moment and some from jealous fear. This was hardly the meaning of knowing the mandate and yielding to the Way of Heaven.
units.literal: Moreover, the princes of Henan, Hejian, Leling, and the others, some because of suspicion at the time and others because of jealous mistrust, all died without guilt; this was not what is meant by knowing the mandate and entrusting oneself to the Way of Heaven.

units.zh: 庚申，詔大使巡行天下，求政善惡，問人疾苦，擢進賢良。
units.en: On gengshen, senior envoys were ordered to tour the realm, investigate good and bad government, ask after the people's suffering, and promote worthy talent.
units.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict sent senior envoys to tour the realm, seek out what was good and bad in government, ask after the people's hardships, and promote the worthy and capable.

units.zh: 河清元年春正月乙亥，車駕至自晉陽。
units.en: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Heqing, on yihai, the emperor returned from Jinyang.
units.literal: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Heqing, on the yihai day, the imperial carriage arrived back from Jinyang.

units.zh: 二年春正月乙亥，帝詔臨朝堂策試秀才。
units.en: In the second year, on the yihai day of the first month of spring, the emperor issued an edict for a court examination of xiucai scholars in the hall of audience.
units.literal: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the yihai day, the Emperor issued an edict for a court examination of xiucai scholars in the hall of audience.

units.zh: 三年春正月庚申朔，周軍至城下而陳，戰於城西。
units.en: In spring of the third year, on the gengshen day—the first of the month—the Northern Zhou army reached the walls, drew up in battle order, and fought west of the city.
units.literal: In spring of the third year, on the gengshen day, the new moon, the Northern Zhou army reached below the city walls and deployed in battle order; they fought west of the city.

units.zh: 四年春正月癸卯，以大將軍、任城王湝為大司馬。
units.en: In spring of the fourth year, on the guimao day of the first month, Grand General Prince Jun of Rencheng was appointed grand marshal.
units.literal: In spring of the fourth year, on the guimao day of the first month, Grand General Prince Cheng of Rencheng was made grand marshal.

units.zh: 孝昭幸晉陽，帝以懿親居守鄴，政事咸見委託。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao went to Jinyang, the prince remained at Ye as a trusted kinsman, and all government affairs were entrusted to him.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao went to Jinyang, the Emperor, as a close kinsman, remained to guard Ye, and all government affairs were entrusted to him.

units.zh: 五年二月甲申，葬於永平陵。
units.en: In the second month of the fifth year, on the jiashen day, he was buried at Yongping Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, on the jiashen day, he was buried at Yongping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 神武用竇泰策，縱反間，度律、仲遠不戰而還。
units.en: Using Dou Tai's counsel, Gao Huan spread discord and Dulü and Zhongyuan withdrew without fighting.
units.literal: Shenwu used Dou Tai's stratagem, set loose counter-intelligence; Dulü and Zhongyuan returned without battle.

units.zh: 其酋帥吐陳等感恩，皆從指麾，救曹泥，取万俟受洛干，大收其用。
units.en: Their chieftains such as Tuchen were grateful and obeyed every order—rescuing Cao Ni and taking Moqi Shouluogan—proving of great use.
units.literal: Their chieftains such as Tuchen were grateful and obeyed every order — rescuing Cao Ni and taking Moqi Shouluogan — and proved of great use.

units.zh: 及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。
units.en: When he came to the throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others served jointly as his advisers.
units.literal: When he inherited the great throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others assisted him together.

units.zh: 孝昭將入雲龍門，都督成休寧列仗拒而不內，歸彥諭之，然後得入，進向柏閤、永巷亦如之。
units.en: When Xiaozhao was about to enter the Cloud-Dragon Gate, commander Cheng Xiuning drew up his troops and barred the way. Guiyan talked him round — only then was entry granted. The same at Cypress Pavilion and Eternal Lane.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao was about to enter the Cloud-Dragon Gate, Commander Cheng Xiuning drew up troops and barred him; Guiyan persuaded him, and only then was entry granted — proceeding toward the Cypress Pavilion and the Eternal Lane, the same again.

units.zh: 醜其行事，私與尉景、段榮、蔡儁圖之。
units.en: Disgusted by Luozhou's methods, he secretly plotted with Wei Jing, Duan Rong, and Cai Jun.
units.literal: He loathed Luozhou's conduct and secretly with Jing, Duan Rong, and Cai Jun plotted against him.

units.zh: 后呼榮求救，賴榮遽下取之以免。
units.en: Empress Wuming cried to Duan Rong for help, and Rong leapt down in time to catch the boy and save him.
units.literal: The empress called to Rong for rescue; thanks to Rong quickly descending to take him up, he was spared.

units.zh: 帝使齊帥裴澤、主書蔡暉伺察群下，好相誣枉，朝士呼為裴、蔡。
units.en: The emperor had the Qi commander Pei Ze and document clerk Cai Hui spy on the host below, fond of mutual slander; court gentlemen called them Pei and Cai.
units.literal: The emperor had the Qi commander Pei Ze and document clerk Cai Hui spy on the host below, fond of mutual slander; court gentlemen called them Pei and Cai.
